name: Zadok
overview: Zadok was a male figure known for his role in repairing the wall of Jerusalem, as recorded in Nehemiah 3:4. He is also mentioned among the signatories of the sealed covenant document in Nehemiah 10:21. While his tribal affiliation is not specified, his contributions to the restoration efforts highlight his active participation in the post-exilic community.
namesAndTitles: The name Zadok means 'righteous one' in Hebrew, reflecting a character associated with righteousness. This proper name, though not indicated as given by God, aligns with his faithful service in the rebuilding of Jerusalem.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Zadok was the father of Baana, as noted in Nehemiah 3:4. Beyond this explicit relationship, no further family details are provided.
scriptureSignificance: Zadok's significance lies in his tangible contribution to the physical and spiritual restoration of Jerusalem following the exile. His work on the city wall symbolizes a commitment to protecting and preserving the covenant community. Additionally, his inclusion among those who sealed the covenant document underscores his dedication to upholding the renewed commitment to God's law.
